shared_elements: tall pale stone slab with carved low relief
horizontal registers divided by incised lines
a top band of repeated small motifs (winged disc/uraei vs. row of quadrupeds)
figures with raised arms / limbs shown in flat side view
justification: Both are tall pale stone slabs organised into stacked horizontal registers, each with a crowded band of repeated small motifs across the top followed by larger profile figures below, which gives a genuinely comparable compositional scheme. The manner of execution differs sharply, however: A is densely covered with fine, shallow incision including rows of script-like signs and seated human figures, while B is sparsely populated with bold, rounded, high-relief animal forms and no writing.
